about_the_game:
A Narrative Roguelike About Chaos, Choice, and Cosmic Discovery

In Veilbreaker, the universe has unraveled. You play against increasing entropy - a creeping force that destabilizes reality itself. You are a fragment of resistance in a collapsed world, tasked with uncovering forgotten truths and stabilizing the timeline by finding stabilizing story fragments.

In this retro inspired rogue-like bullethell, you increase the world tier to face greater threats, but with them comes more entropy. Seek out lore encounters that includes narrative-rich moments for you to discover what happened in the universe.

Key Features:

  • Lore-Driven Progression: Discover Lore Segments and experience the entropy filled universe with a set of stories and characters to follow.

  • Roguelike Core: Unlock persistent upgrades and new story threads

  • Entropy System: The higher your world tier, the more chaotic and difficult your runs become. Stabilize it by discovering Lore Segments

  • Strategic Encounters: Customize your path. Choose which factions to align with, and pursue the true ending.

Will You Restore What Was Lost Or Let the Void Take It All?

This is a game for players who love mystery, challenge, and meaning behind the mechanics. If you're drawn to narrative-rich roguelikes with high replayability and cosmic stakes, your story begins here.
